_comment: What a deployment is for, as data (Game/Mission/Objectives): each template a list of steps -- kind restore_power, download (the terminal worked while somebody stays at it; or the data got out of a server rack: pulled, or copied onto the copy unit), board (a rack's damaged drive fitted with a board from another rack), unit (the copy unit brought from the shuttle and connected to a rack), fuel, prime and valves (a plant's chain, only_when_chain: its generator fuelled from a can, its pump primed by hand, its valves set to their plate), readings (each of the mission's markers worked) carry (back to the shuttle) or code (a secured terminal's access code found and entered; only_when_secured) repair (a faulted terminal's supply box mended; only_when_faulted) or route (a cut feed switched over at the feeder cabinet; only_when_feed_cut) -- with the steps done before each (after), what the crew is told (text), a line under it while it is open (hint; hint_no_map when the briefing came without a map), what is shown while it is under way (working, with how far it has got; paused under it while it is held: no power), whether it is only there when the power is out (only_when_power_out), where the data is (only_at_terminal, only_when_pull, only_when_damaged, only_when_archive, not_when_archive, not_at_pulled_rack: a drive pulled from a rack wants no power) and whether the crew only learns of it on finding the terminal dead (learnt_at_terminal). A template also has what the briefing's screen lists (brief; brief_variants, by how it is done: rack, damaged, archive, chain) and how the result is headed (done, failed). Which template a mission is laid from is its kind's: download_data, restore (a station), survey, signal, activate (a facility whose plant is to be started), revive (a signal gone silent, brought back). Read again when it changes while the game runs.

templates.name: Recover the data
brief: LOCATE THE TERMINAL
DOWNLOAD THE DATA
BRING THE DRIVE BACK TO THE SHUTTLE

rack: OPEN ITS DRIVE BAY AND PULL THE DRIVE
BRING THE DRIVE BACK TO THE SHUTTLE
damaged: FIT ITS DAMAGED DRIVE WITH A BOARD FROM ANOTHER RACK
BRING IT BACK TO THE SHUTTLE
archive: TAKE THE COPY UNIT FROM THE SHUTTLE
CONNECT IT TO THE SERVER RACK AND COPY THE ARCHIVE
BRING THE UNIT BACK TO THE SHUTTLE

steps.text: Restore the power at the building's breaker board.
steps.hint: The terminal is dead until then.

steps.text: The building has no incoming supply: switch it to the standby feed at its feeder cabinet.
steps.hint: The cabinet stands outside, by one of its doors.

steps.text: The terminal has no supply: repair its supply box.
steps.hint: The box is on the wall over the bench. Its cover screws need a multitool; a circuit tester shows which fuse has gone.

steps.text: The terminal is secured: find its access code and enter it.
steps.hint: Somebody here will have written it down. Search the other rooms.

steps.text: Download the data from the terminal.
steps.hint_no_map: No map data for this site: search the buildings.
steps.paused: Paused: the terminal has no power.

steps.text: The data is in a server rack: open its drive bay and pull the drive.
steps.hint: The bay is on the face of one of the racks in a server room.

steps.text: The rack's drive is damaged: fit it with a controller board from another rack.
steps.hint: Draw the drive's sled out to its board. Another rack's service hatch has a board; a multitool takes it out.

steps.text: Pull the repaired drive.
The archive is too big for a drive: bring the copy unit from the shuttle and connect it to the rack.
steps.hint: The unit is on the bench in the shuttle's cabin. Open the rack's drive bay; the port is beside the drive.

steps.text: Copy the archive onto the unit.
steps.paused: Paused: the rack has no power.

steps.text: Disconnect the copy unit and take it back to the shuttle.
steps.hint: It is heavy. Anything that heard it copying may be close.

steps.text: Take the drive to the shuttle.
steps.hint: It is waiting on the pad.

templates.name: Restore the station
brief: RESTORE THE STATION'S POWER
RESTART LIFE SUPPORT AT THE CONTROL CONSOLE
RETURN TO THE SHUTTLE

steps.text: Restore the power at the station's breaker board.
steps.hint: Nothing in the station runs until then.

steps.text: The building has no incoming supply: switch it to the standby feed at its feeder cabinet.
steps.hint: The cabinet stands outside, by one of its doors.

steps.text: The console has no supply: repair its supply box.
steps.hint: The box is on the wall over the bench. Its cover screws need a multitool; a circuit tester shows which fuse has gone.

steps.text: Restart life support at the control console.
steps.hint_no_map: No map data for this site: search the buildings.
steps.paused: Paused: the console has no power.

steps.text: Return to the shuttle.
steps.hint: It is waiting on the pad.

templates.name: Survey the site
brief: SET UP A MARKER AT EACH SURVEY POINT
READINGS NEED THREE WORKING AT ONCE
BRING THE READINGS BACK TO THE SHUTTLE
THE MARKERS ARE IN THE CRATE IN THE SHUTTLE

steps.text: Set up a marker at each survey point.
steps.hint: The markers are in the crate in the shuttle. Plant one at a point's flag, kick its legs out, level it and switch it on.

steps.text: Take the readings.
steps.hint: A reading needs three markers working at once.
steps.paused: Paused: fewer than three markers working.

steps.text: Take the readings back to the shuttle.
steps.hint: It is waiting on the pad.

templates.name: Trace the signal
brief: TRACK THE SIGNAL DOWN WITH THE DIRECTION FINDER
SHUT THE TRANSMITTER DOWN
RETURN TO THE SHUTTLE

steps.text: Track the signal down to its transmitter and shut it down.
steps.hint: The direction finder on the shuttle's bench swings towards it -- steadier the nearer. The tracker knows it once it is found.

steps.text: Return to the shuttle.
steps.hint: It is waiting on the pad.

templates.name: Start the plant
brief: RESTORE THE FACILITY'S POWER IF IT IS OUT
START ITS PLANT AT THE CONTROL CONSOLE
RETURN TO THE SHUTTLE

chain: FUEL THE GENERATOR FROM THE STORES
PRIME THE PUMP AND SET THE VALVES
START THE PLANT AT THE CONTROL CONSOLE

steps.text: Restore the power at the building's breaker board.
steps.hint: The console is dead until then.

steps.text: The building has no incoming supply: switch it to the standby feed at its feeder cabinet.
steps.hint: The cabinet stands outside, by one of its doors.

steps.text: The console has no supply: repair its supply box.
steps.hint: The box is on the wall over the bench. Its cover screws need a multitool; a circuit tester shows which fuse has gone.

steps.text: The plant's generator is dry: bring a fuel can and fill its tank.
steps.hint: The can is on a bench in another room; the generator's filler is on a wall over a bench. Open its cap first.

steps.text: Prime the plant's pump by hand.
steps.hint: Work its lever until its gauge reads full.

steps.text: Set the plant's valves to the line-up on their plate.
steps.hint: Each handwheel opens or shuts. Turned while the plant starts, it trips.

steps.text: Start the plant at the control console, a system at a time.
steps.hint_no_map: No map data for this site: search the buildings.
steps.paused: Paused: the console has no power.

steps.text: Return to the shuttle.
steps.hint: It is waiting on the pad.

templates.name: Bring the signal back
brief: FIND THE TRANSMITTER THAT HAS GONE SILENT
BRING IT BACK ON THE AIR
RETURN TO THE SHUTTLE

steps.text: Find the silent transmitter and bring it back on the air.
steps.hint: The tracker has its last known position.

steps.text: Return to the shuttle.
steps.hint: It is waiting on the pad.

templates.name: Look round the site
brief: NO CONTRACT HERE
LOOK ROUND AND GATHER WHAT YOU CAN
RETURN TO THE SHUTTLE WHEN YOU ARE DONE

steps.text: Look round, gather what you can, and return to the shuttle when you are done.
steps.hint: It waits on the pad: leave whenever you like.

templates.name: Set up the beacon
brief: CARRY THE BEACON'S PARTS UP TO THE HIGH GROUND
PUT IT TOGETHER: MAST, DISH, POWER CELL
AIM IT AS ITS PLATE SAYS AND SWITCH IT ON
RETURN TO THE SHUTTLE

steps.text: Carry the beacon's parts up to the site's high ground and put it together: mast, dish, then power cell.
steps.hint: The parts are in the crate in the shuttle. Each one takes both hands.

steps.text: Aim the dish as the beacon's plate says, and switch it on.
steps.hint: Its knobs turn the dish round and up, a step at a time.

steps.text: Return to the shuttle.
steps.hint: It is waiting on the pad.

templates.name: Bring back samples
brief: TAKE THE COLD CASE FROM THE SHUTTLE
DRILL A CORE AT EACH OF THE THREE OUTCROPS
BRING THE CASE BACK BEFORE IT WARMS

steps.text: Drill a core at each of the three outcrops, straight into the cold case.
steps.hint: The cold case is on the bench in the shuttle. Away from the shuttle it keeps them cold only so long.

steps.text: Bring the cold case back aboard the shuttle before it warms.
steps.hint: Warmed through, the cores spoil and must be drilled again.
